channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Não temos controle sobre preço dos combustíveis porque BR Distribuidora foi vendida, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized the privatization of BR Distribuidora, stating that the government lost control over fuel prices in Brazil. He linked this loss of control to the inability to counteract the impacts of the war between the United States, Israel, and Iran on the international energy market.

item.title: A opinião de Kassab sobre possibilidade de chapa pura de Caiado à presidência da República
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, stated that a pure ticket headed by Ronaldo Caiado for the presidency is a concrete hypothesis, but stressed that several stages and understandings are still needed within and outside the party before a final decision is made. He emphasized that the final word belongs to Caiado after consultation with party bodies and supporting forces, and that he is ready to abide by any collective decision.

item.title: Lula bloqueia R$ 23,7 bi do orçamento federal de 2026
item.description: President Lula signed Decree 12.990/2026, blocking R$ 23.7 billion in discretionary federal spending for 2026, as required by the fiscal framework. The cut affects nearly all ministries, with Defense, Cities, Education, Regional Integration, Transport, and Health accounting for 68% of the total. While the measure aims to adjust public accounts, the projected primary deficit of R$ 60.3 billion remains below the fiscal target's midpoint, requiring an additional R$ 30 billion adjustment to avoid non-compliance.

item.title: Torcida organizada do Atlético-MG fará protesto contra Flávio
item.description: The organized fan group Força Atleticana Revolucionária of Atlético Mineiro has called a protest against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) on June 2, 2026, in front of Belo Horizonte’s City Council, due to the conferral of an honorary citizenship title. The group denounced the honor as a "mockery of the city and democracy," claiming the PL is attacking institutions and persecuting workers. Following the 5 p.m. ceremony, Bolsonaro will attend events at Sesc Palladium and the Megaleite 2026 dairy expo as part of his presidential pre-campaign.

item.title: Lula diz que esquerda terá de usar verde e amarelo na Copa ‘para não deixar cores do Brasil serem tomadas’
item.description: At an event in Rio de Janeiro, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that the left must learn to wear Brazil’s green and yellow colors during the World Cup to prevent national symbols from being claimed exclusively by bolsonarism. He praised Rio’s mayor for wearing the national team jersey and emphasized that the flag’s colors belong to all Brazilians, not a single political faction. Lula also criticized the preference for foreign travel over domestic exploration, urging Brazilians to value their own culture, history, and the Amazon more deeply.

item.title: A acusação da equipe de Flávio à ofensiva de base de Lula contra presidenciável na PGR
item.description: Rogério Marinho, coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign, responded to Psol and Rede legislators’ move to ask the PGR to investigate Flávio Bolsonaro for alleged attack on national sovereignty, claiming the left is using the judiciary as a political tool. He defended Flávio’s work with the Trump administration to designate PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, stating that seeking international cooperation against crime is legitimate and necessary to protect the population. Marinho accused the left of protecting criminals and seeking foreign interference for ideological reasons, while the right focuses on dismantling criminal factions.

item.title: Deputados levam à PGR encontros de Flávio com Trump e Rubio
item.description: Members of the Lula government base filed a representation with the PGR accusing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of an attack on national sovereignty for meeting with Donald Trump and Marco Rubio to influence the U.S. designation of PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations. The deputies argue that foreign relations are the exclusive competence of the Brazilian president and that Bolsonaro lacked legitimacy to negotiate such measures with foreign governments, despite celebrating the decision on social media. The representation requests a federal police investigation, assessment of abuse of power, and notification to the TSE to evaluate possible foreign influence in the 2026 Brazilian elections.

item.title: Kassab diz estar “à disposição” para vice em chapa com Caiado
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, said he is available to run as vice president in a ticket with Goiás Governor Ronaldo Caiado in the 2026 elections. He said he felt honored by internal party indications, but stressed that the final decision will depend on strategic and party evaluations.

item.title: A bola de neve econômica que pode atingir Lula por suas próprias políticas
item.description: The article examines how temporary public spending measures adopted by Lula's government in an election year — such as fuel subsidies — could create an economic 'snowball,' increasing public debt and undermining fiscal credibility. Experts warn that, despite low immediate political cost, these policies will force harder fiscal adjustments in the future, regardless of who is in power, due to eroded confidence in the fiscal framework.

item.title: Deputados pedem investigação sobre suposta articulação de Flávio nos EUA
item.description: Lawmakers from PSOL and Rede, allies of President Lula’s government, filed a request with Brazil’s Attorney General’s Office (PGR) to investigate Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged lobbying with the U.S. government that led to the designation of PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations. The complaint was filed following claims of improper influence in international security decisions. The case raises concerns about the misuse of diplomatic channels for personal or political gain.

item.title: Kassab não descarta composição do PSD com Zema, mas decisão fica para julho
item.description: The national president of the PSD, Gilberto Kassab, stated that the party remains open to a potential alliance with former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) in the 2026 presidential race, but the final decision on the party’s direction will be made in July.

item.title: O vinho que nasceu no terroir de Lula na zona do agreste de Pernambuco
item.description: In Garanhuns, in the Pernambuco Agreste, the Vale das Colinas winery transformed a former pasture into a national reference for high-altitude wine production, inspired by Lula’s birthplace. With 14 hectares of vineyards at 900 meters altitude, the estate produces 29,000 bottles annually of award-winning reds and whites, creating formal jobs and boosting regional tourism. The success stems from a tropical mountain microclimate with significant thermal variation, which preserves acidity and enhances aromas without invasive techniques.

item.title: Aliados de Lula pedem que PGR investigue Flávio Bolsonaro por possível atentado à soberania nacional
item.description: Allies of President Lula have asked Brazil’s General Prosecutor’s Office (PGR) to investigate Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for allegedly threatening national sovereignty after he advocated for designating the PCC and CV as global terrorist organizations to the Trump administration. The request cites his meetings with Donald Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio, claiming his lobbying influenced the U.S. decision, which could lead to economic sanctions or even military intervention in Brazil. Flávio celebrated the move on social media, while his campaign defends the effort as a legitimate fight against crime.

item.title: Rede e PSOL acionam PGR para apurar se Flávio atentou contra a soberania nacional
item.description: PSOL and Rede lawmakers have asked the PGR to investigate Flávio Bolsonaro for allegedly committing a crime against national sovereignty, after he met with U.S. officials to urge the designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations. They claim this was part of an aggressive lobbying effort by the Bolsonaro family for their own benefit, citing prior actions such as supporting the 'tariff shock' against Brazil.

item.title: Torcida do Galo convoca ato contra homenagem a Flávio Bolsonaro em BH
item.description: The Atlético Mineiro organized fan group FAR (Força Atleticana Revolucionária) called for a protest in front of Belo Horizonte City Council against the honorary citizenship award to Flávio Bolsonaro, a presidential pre-candidate. The group condemned the honor as a 'mockery of Belo Horizonte and democracy,' arguing the legislature should address real city issues instead. The award, proposed by PL party councilmembers, is part of Bolsonaro’s electoral agenda in Minas Gerais, which includes appearances at Megaleite 2026 and an event at Sesc Palladium.

item.title: O vale-tudo do governo Lula no crédito chega a R$ 230 bilhões, mostra estudo
item.description: The Lula government is considering credit stimulus packages that could inject up to R$ 230 billion into the economy in 2026, including payroll-deductible credit for private workers, real estate financing, loans for taxi and app-based drivers, trucks, buses, and agricultural machinery, plus BNDES programs such as Brazil Sovereign 2.0 and Industry 4.0 Credit. According to João Paulo Pio of FIEMG, this may raise core inflation by up to 0.5 percentage points in 12–18 months, potentially forcing the Central Bank to reverse its current interest rate-cutting cycle and worsening fiscal pressures despite a projected primary surplus of 0.25% of GDP (R$ 34.3 billion).

item.title: Até maio, pacote de bondades de Lula é o dobro do de Bolsonaro
item.description: From January to May 2026, President Lula spent R$ 184.7 billion on social programs, double the amount spent by Bolsonaro in the same period of 2022 (R$ 74.5 billion, inflation-adjusted). Lula's package includes measures for truckers, app drivers, income tax exemption, housing, cooking gas, and fuel subsidies, while Bolsonaro focused on student loan forgiveness and industrial tax cuts.

item.title: Governistas acionam PGR contra Flávio Bolsonaro após trama com Trump sobre PCC e CV
item.description: Governist federal deputies filed a representation with the PGR requesting an investigation into Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for allegedly acting with the U.S. government to designate PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations, which they claim undermines national sovereignty. They argue that foreign relations are an exclusive presidential prerogative and that the senator overstepped his authority without parliamentary immunity protection. The deputies also ask the TSE to assess potential foreign influence or electoral misconduct in the context of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Após ação de Trump, Lula quer acelerar criação de Ministério da Segurança
item.description: President Lula has decided to accelerate the creation of a Ministry of Public Security, separating it from the Ministry of Justice, in response to the Trump administration's designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations. The move aims to strengthen Brazil’s response to organized crime and assert autonomy amid external pressures.

item.title: Lula morde a isca de Flávio
item.description: The Lula government succeeded in pushing through the Chamber of Deputies a controversial PEC proposing the end of the 6×1 work schedule, gaining support even from parts of the opposition. The proposal, labeled as irresponsible and misleading, promises improved working conditions but lacks substantive grounding. The article criticizes the opposition for failing to mount a coherent counterargument against the initiative.

item.title: Tela Brasil: streaming de Lula tem custo de R$ 9 mi e 555 filmes
item.description: President Lula and Minister Margareth Menezes launch Tela Brasil, a free public streaming platform featuring 555 Brazilian audiovisual works from 1910 to 2025, with a R$ 9 million investment and Gov.br login access. Developed by NEES/UFAL with Serpro infrastructure, the platform includes Oscar-nominated films and classics like 'Central do Brasil,' with no ads or behavioral tracking.

item.title: As novas peças de campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The first social media campaign pieces for Flávio Bolsonaro are set to launch next week, already produced by the team led by Eduardo Fischer. The content is exclusive to subscribers and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Bahia x Botafogo no Brasileirão: onde assistir ao vivo, horário e escalações
item.description: Bahia and Botafogo face off this Saturday, May 30, 2026, at 5:30 PM Brasília time, in the 18th round of the Brasileirão Série A at Arena Fonte Nova. Bahia aims to end an eight-game winless streak, while Botafogo comes off a strong performance in the Copa Sudamericana. The match will be broadcast on TV Globo and Premiere, with projected lineups released and betting odds slightly favoring Bahia.

item.title: Moraes devolve passaporte a Marcos do Val e derruba restrição para senador sair do país
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes lifted travel restrictions and returned the diplomatic passport of Senator Marcos do Val (Podemos-ES) after the Attorney General’s Office determined there is no longer a flight risk. The senator had previously faced measures including passport retention, electronic ankle monitoring, and social media bans for violating a court order and launching a public campaign against Federal Police delegate Fabio Shor, who leads investigations into Bolsonaro and the January 8 attacks. Despite claiming parliamentary immunity, his actions — including an unauthorized trip abroad with his daughter — were deemed impermissible.

item.title: Tarcísio tem 48,3% e Haddad, 36,5% no 2º turno em SP, diz pesquisa
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads with 48.3% voting intention in a potential second round for governor of São Paulo against Fernando Haddad, who has 36.5%, according to Vox Brasil poll. In the first-round scenario, Tarcísio has 45.8%, Haddad 34.8%, and Paulo Serra 6.9%. The survey interviewed 1,480 voters from May 26–28, with a margin of error of 2.55 percentage points and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Messias volta à campanha pelo STF e participa mais uma vez da Marcha para Jesus
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias will participate for the fourth consecutive year in the March for Jesus in São Paulo, following the Senate's rejection of his Supreme Court nomination. President Lula plans to resubmit Messias's name for senatorial approval, aiming to rebuild political support after earlier articulation failures and tensions with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Messias is regarded by the government as Lula's main liaison with the evangelical electorate, a demographic where the president has historically struggled.

item.title: PSD discute lançar Kassab como vice de Caiado para frear aliança com Zema
item.description: The PSD is considering nominating Gilberto Kassab, the party's president, as the vice-presidential candidate on Ronaldo Caiado's ticket to counter efforts to form an alliance with Romeu Zema (Novo) as the presidential nominee. The move aims to preserve the PSD's influence as a central broker in the center-right opposition to Lula's government in 2026, preventing Zema from leading the ticket. This reflects internal competition among center-right parties over who should head the alternative to the current administration.

item.title: Governo detalha bloqueio de R$ 23,7 bilhões no Orçamento e atinge emendas parlamentares
item.description: The Lula government detailed a R$ 23.7 billion budget blockade for 2026 to comply with the fiscal framework, affecting parliamentary amendments (R$ 4.9 billion) and ministries such as Defense, Cities, and Education. The measure was required due to increased mandatory spending on pensions and the BPC, which reduced space for discretionary expenses. The blockade combines R$ 22.1 billion in new containment with a prior block to avoid violating fiscal rules.

item.title: “É uma ameaça à democracia, ao país, ao povo”, diz Alckmin sobre Flávio
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential candidacy poses a threat to democracy, the country, and the people. He compared the current situation to the period before Lula's election, asserting that Flávio's candidacy is not legitimate but rather an institutional risk.

item.title: Governistas acionam PGR para apurar se Flávio atentou contra a soberania em lobby nos EUA
item.description: Government-aligned deputies have asked the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to investigate whether Senator Flávio Bolsonaro committed a crime against national sovereignty by lobbying in the United States. The accusation claims his activities in the U.S. interfered with Brazil's internal affairs or undermined the country's independence. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Caiado participa de lançamento da pré-candidatura de Gabriel Souza ao governo do RS
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD's pre-candidate for President of Brazil, attended the launch of Gabriel Souza's pre-candidacy for governor of Rio Grande do Sul under the MDB, in an event in Porto Alegre's North Zone. The event took place on Saturday (30), following Caiado's schedule in Caxias do Sul and a dinner with allies on Friday. Also present were pre-candidate for vice-governor Ernani Polo (PSD) and senatorial pre-candidates Germano Rigotto (MDB) and Frederico Antunes (PSD).

item.title: Os riscos após a classificação de facções como terroristas
item.description: The U.S. designation of PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations raises risks of economic sanctions, intelligence restrictions, and potential CIA covert operations in Brazil. President Lula confirmed he will renominate Jorge Messias to the Supreme Court, citing Senate rejection as politically motivated. Meanwhile, Brazilian courts have detected the first cases of prompt injection — where lawyers use AI to manipulate judicial systems — prompting STJ investigations and sanctions.

item.title: Iliberalismo à brasileira: a exceção como regra
item.description: The text argues that Brazil has conflated criticism of authorities with attacks on the State, undermining the essential liberal democratic distinction between person and institution. This leads to selective application of the law, where immunities and privileged forums depend on arbitrary interpretations, characterizing an 'illiberal democracy'. The author defends constitutional rigor and freedom of expression — including criticism of the Judiciary — as lost pillars in recent years.

item.title: Moro lança pré-candidatura ao governo do Paraná ao lado de Flávio
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) launched his pre-candidacy for governor of Paraná at a PL event in Curitiba, joined by opposition allies to President Lula, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), former prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol (Novo), and federal deputy Filipe Barros (PL-PR). The event, held on March 29, strengthens the right-wing coalition in Paraná ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Kassab admite possibilidade de compor chapa com Caiado, mas diz que decisão será tomada em julho
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, admitted the possibility of a pure PSD ticket for the 2026 elections, with Ronaldo Caiado as presidential candidate and himself as vice president, but stated the decision will be made in July. The party is also considering an alternative scenario of a broad center-right alliance, including talks with Romeu Zema. Kassab denied personal ambition for the vice-presidential role, saying his priority is ensuring Caiado's victory.

item.title: Lula deve telefonar para Trump após EUA classificarem PCC e CV como terroristas
item.description: Lula is expected to call Trump in the coming days to discuss the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, expressing concerns over potential harm to Brazil’s economy, fintechs, and the PIX payment system. The Brazilian government accuses the U.S. of sovereignty interference and politically motivated action, while Flávio Bolsonaro claims he and his brother influenced the decision after meeting with Trump at the White House.

item.title: Pesquisas indicam clima de segundo turno antecipado em grandes estados do país
item.description: Polls indicate that in at least four strategic states, including São Paulo, gubernatorial races are already showing characteristics of an anticipated runoff, with only two candidates concentrating around 80% of voting intentions. In São Paulo, Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and former minister Fernando Haddad (PT) dominate the race, backed by broad party coalitions and replaying the 2022 national duel, while other candidates trail with less than 5% each.

item.title: Governo Lula vê interferência dos EUA nas eleições e não descarta novas ações de Trump após medida sobre PCC e Comando Vermelho
item.description: The Lula government views the U.S. designation of the Red Command and PCC as foreign terrorist organizations as an attempt to interfere in Brazil's 2026 elections to benefit Flávio Bolsonaro. Presidential aides believe the move had explicit approval from Donald Trump and fear further U.S. actions, such as additional tariffs, during the electoral period.

item.title: Ainda estamos aqui: escala 6×1 e a herança colonial do trabalho doméstico
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a PEC ending the 6×1 work scale and reducing the maximum weekly workweek to 40 hours with two days off, one preferably on Sundays. Simultaneously, an exhibition at the Instituto Moreira Salles honors Laudelina de Campos Mello, founder of Brazil’s first domestic workers’ association in 1936. IBGE and FNPETI data show 84,000 children in domestic work, 85% girls and 70% Black, revealing the enduring colonial and antidirect structures in Brazilian domestic labor.

item.title: Aliados defendem que direita baixe a régua ética para apoiar Flávio Bolsonaro na era Vorcaro
item.description: Allies of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro argue that the right must relax its ethical stance to support him in the electoral campaign, following revelations of his close ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro, who was previously imprisoned for banking fraud. They claim that visiting a former inmate and seeking financial support do not constitute corruption, but rather reflect the candidate's 'immaturity', and stress the need to prevent Lula from labeling him corrupt in a 'narrative war'. The goal is to preserve Flávio Bolsonaro's electoral viability as the PL's presidential candidate despite ethical concerns.

item.title: O eleitor brasileiro mudou de idade
item.description: The Brazilian electorate is aging, with the average voter age increasing by 4.5 years between 2002 and 2026, reshaping electoral preferences. This demographic shift is gradually giving greater influence to older voters, who benefit from expanded welfare programs, and is altering the country's political axis.

item.title: Vínculo do PCC com setor de combustíveis eleva risco para Brasil após decisão de Trump
item.description: Revelations that the Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) operates in Brazil's formal fuel market have raised concerns within the Lula government about systemic risks to national financial agents. This follows the U.S. designation of criminal factions as terrorists under Trump, which could trigger sanctions and restrict access to international financial systems. The government assesses that the infiltration of organized crime into legitimate sectors heightens economic and national security vulnerabilities.

item.title: Governo bloqueia R$ 4,6 bi em emendas para cumprir regras fiscais; trava também atinge ministérios
item.description: The Lula government blocked R$ 4.6 billion in parliamentary amendments to ensure compliance with fiscal rules, amid rising mandatory spending on pension and social benefits. The measure also affected funds allocated to ministries, reflecting efforts to contain the primary deficit and maintain fiscal responsibility.

item.title: Como funciona a ajuda humanitária que o Brasil enviou para Bolívia
item.description: The government of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva sent humanitarian aid to Bolivia via a Brazilian Air Force KC-390 aircraft carrying 21 tons of food, including 16 tons of rice and 5 tons of powdered milk, following a request from Bolivian leader Rodrigo Paz. The operation was coordinated by the Itamaraty, Ministry of Defense, MDA, and MDS, under Law No. 12,429/2011, which authorizes the executive to donate public food stocks for international humanitarian assistance, with the UN World Food Programme (WFP) responsible for transportation costs, which may be reimbursed or covered by PGPM and PAA budget allocations.

item.title: Sábado de Brasileirão conta com Flamengo e outros quatro jogos; veja
item.description: In the 18th round of the Brasileirão, Flamengo aims to rebound from a 3-0 loss to Palmeiras against Coritiba, missing nine players released for the 2026 World Cup. Coritiba, on a two-match winning streak, seeks to reach the G4 with a win. Other fixtures include Athletico-PR vs Mirassol, Grêmio vs Corinthians, and Bahia vs Botafogo, all impacting the race for the top eight or survival from relegation.

item.title: Governo Lula dá novo subsídio ao diesel, de R$ 0,35 por litro
item.description: The Lula government announced a diesel subsidy of R$ 0.35 per liter, effective June 1, 2026, for two months, to offset the impact of ending federal tax exemptions on fuel. The measure, published in an extra edition of the Official Gazette, aims to prevent price hikes at the pump amid international oil price pressures, with Brent crude peaking at $119.50 in March 2026 and now trading near $90. The subsidy operates as a tax cashback, reimbursing producers and importers after tax payment.

item.title: O vale-tudo do projeto de poder bolsonarista
item.description: The text portrays Bolsonarism as an unbounded project of power, involving doubts about electronic voting machines, attacks on authorities and institutions, plotting coups and assassinations, inciting foreign sanctions, and seeking to label criminal factions as terrorists to provoke economic retaliation from the U.S. All aimed at consolidating an authoritarian agenda, even at the cost of democratic stability and Brazil’s international relations.

item.title: Oportunidade para virar o jogo contra o crime organizado
item.description: The designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations by the U.S. reflects a strategic articulation involving Flávio Bolsonaro, Eduardo Bolsonaro, and their circle, aligned with Washington’s updated counternarcotics policy. Despite polarized debates, this move presents a strategic window of opportunity for Brazil in combating organized crime, even amid associated risks and costs.

item.title: Gangorra eleitoral: Lula e Flávio têm altos e baixos na semana com fim da escala 6x1 e decisão dos EUA sobre facções
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faced reputational damage from leaked messages and a meeting with former banker Vorcaro, but gained momentum after securing the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations following his White House meeting with Trump and officials. Lula celebrated a legislative victory as the Chamber of Deputies advanced a PEC to reduce working hours and end the 6x1 work scale. Both candidates experienced fluctuating public momentum, with Flávio navigating controversies and Lula gaining ground via policy success.

item.title: Com Flávio, PL e Novo lançam Moro e Dallagnol em chapa no PR
item.description: In an event in Curitiba, the PL and Novo parties launched Sergio Moro’s pre-candidacy for governor of Paraná, joined by Flávio Bolsonaro, Deltan Dallagnol, and Filipe Barros. Speeches centered on criticism of the Lula government and the STF, while promoting anti-corruption, public security, and the legacy of Operation Lava Jato, with Dallagnol advocating for STF minister impeachments and Flávio highlighting international efforts to designate PCC and CV as terrorist organizations.
